US Diesel Prices Reach Record High Amidst Iran Conflict

Diesel prices in the United States have reached a record high, averaging $5.85 per gallon. This surge is attributed to the ongoing conflict involving Iran and its impact on oil supply, alongside attacks on Russian refineries. The situation mirrors price increases seen in 2022 following Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Farmers in the UK and US are particularly affected by the "astronomical" jump in fuel costs. Renewed hostilities between the US and Iran have heightened fears of oil supply disruption, with prices on track for significant weekly gains. The conflict has entered its seventh month, impacting global oil supply routes.
